gaps: Programme listing/search pages on INTO sites are JavaScript-rendered (0 results via fetch); programme names and URLs were taken from each centre's sitemap.xml course URLs, names derived from URL slugs.

Fees, durations, intakes, English requirements and progression were read only for OSU International Year One in Business (page fetched) and OSU MBA and M.S. Business graduate pathways (fees from search snippets of official pages); all other programmes have these fields null and need per-page fetches (~250 pages).

OSU IYO Business shows 3 and 4 term options with a single fee of $41,330; a separate OSU 2026-27 PDF reports different IYO totals ($76,578 four terms, $63,876 three terms), not reconciled. OSU graduate pathway fees are per snippet and may be per term.

Europe outside UK: INTO listings found for Saint Louis University Madrid (Spain; direct-entry degrees only, no pathway programmes found), University of Nicosia (Cyprus; MD/DVM degree finder only) and Istituto Marangoni (Italy; page only links to INTO London International Foundation in Art and Design, a UK programme). No Germany, Ireland, Netherlands or France centres found.

US centres with no foundation/pathway/pre-master pages in their sitemaps (direct-entry or ESL only): Rensselaer Polytechnic Institute, Eckerd College, Southern Illinois University, Texas State University, University of Oklahoma, Montclair State University, UMass Amherst, Long Island University Brooklyn, Long Island University Post, Colorado State University, Fisher College, New England College, Thomas Jefferson University.

Excluded: Integrated Master's Programs (degree programmes with built-in pathway), International Direct, Academic English, Study Abroad with English, Visiting International Student Program, and Drew test page international-foundation-in-humanities-and-law-test-max. Suffolk Graduate Certificates included as Pre-Master (graduate certificate pathway); this classification is a judgement call.

Undergraduate Transfer Programs typed as Pathway. GMU sitemap showed 4 International Year One two-term programmes; its other pages (e.g. graduate) were not reviewed beyond course slugs listed. Sitemaps for intostudy.com truncated; centre cities are general knowledge, not read from provider pages.
Type for Hofstra/Illinois State etc. follows slug prefix (graduate-pathway = Pre-Master). Some names have approximated capitalisation from slugs.
